messages:
Iris: Hey design — need a slim launch asset bundle for next Thu's benchmark webinar. Deliverables: hero slide (16:9), three benchmark tiles (latency / cost / throughput) with per-region sparklines, a 3s social loop GIF, and a one-slide sales summary (editable). Can someone own exports + naming?

Ben: I can take exports. Request: co-brand-safe muted palette + grayscale print fallback. Also need a PPTX master with editable placeholders for customer name & takeaway.

Camila: i'll lead design and comps. quick Q: should the tiles show "+/- %" as primary and raw numbers as footnote?

Iris: yes — percent primary. raw numbers small beneath, and a tiny data-source line. avoid "fastest" claims; Legal will review.

DesignBot: figma file created -> https://redwood.app/figma/compact-launch-1845010001 (components: hero, bench-tile, gif-timeline). export tokens set for PNG@2x, SVG, GIF, PPTX.

Ben: export naming proposal: compact_hero_EN_v1_1920x1080.png, bench_latency_EN_v1.svg, bench_cost_EN_v1.svg, bench_throughput_EN_v1.svg, compact_gif_EN_v1.gif, sales_slide_EN_v1.PPTX. Add _cobrand for partner variants and locale suffix for translations.

Camila: adding alt-text suggestions and WCAG contrast notes in figma. i'll include a muted color variant and annotate file with exact export settings.

SalesOps: slide needs a 30-40 char editable takeaway and a right-hand small logo area. include two CTA options on the slide: "Register" and "See the numbers". Also need a 140-char plain-text snippet for CRM.

Iris: i'll draft the one-liners and CTAs in the copy CSV. also requesting EN/FR/DE/JA localization. include localized number formatting.

LegalOps: please include a data-source footnote on tiles and use approximate sign (~) where appropriate. no competitor names or direct comparisons. i'll review final copy 48h before publish.

Ben: timeline: sketches Wed morning, drafts Thu morning, final assets Fri EOD. i'll attach an export manifest (readme + file list + plain-text one-liners) with the deliverables.

Camila: uploading first drafts Tue evening. ping me for any copy clarifications.

Iris: thanks team. once Ben uploads the manifest i'll route to sales & legal for quick approvals. :sparkles:
